selection: earliest strict best selection RMSE among trained epochs; no refit
primary_contrast: main policy DM minus D pooled OOF RMSE, mean of seed-wise differences
smoke_sampling: SHA-256 CVE ordering with M-present and M-absent coverage; no score-based selection; sensitivity is a subset of main optimization
interpretation: Exploratory retrospective within-version Day-60 EPSS estimation on previously inspected original training records. Smoke is an integration check, not performance evidence.
sensitivity: Publication-date rule chosen after inspecting cohort support. Filter optimization only, refit preprocessing there, keep selection and assessment unchanged. Changes sample size, composition and optimizer update count; not a causal isolation of the December cohort.
outcome_rules: Keep all fixed folds and all seeds, including weak-support folds. Do not redraw dates or relax purges based on scores.
A primary interval including zero is inconclusive, not proof that posts carry no information.
A subgroup-only or sensitivity-only gain cannot replace an unsupported primary result.
Report CVE and evidence-component paired intervals together; disagreement limits robustness.
RMSE is primary; ranking and high-score slices are secondary. EPSS >=0.1 is not an exploitation label.
No GNN superiority claim can follow from a pooled-text comparison.
Older v3 remains audit-only because selection/tail support and purges limit the usefulness of this bounded follow-up.
The rough group-count interval scaling is not a power calculation. No significance outcome is assumed.
